sources.title: Cloudflare/clef-flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Clef-Flash is a 9B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question in a single forward pass.
